description: This file defines functions and data structures related to extension behavior and extension name handling in the ANGLE project, including extension enumeration, string conversion, and enabling checks.

methods.name: GetExtensionNameString
methods.description: Returns the string name of a given extension enumeration value.

methods.name: GetExtensionByName
methods.description: Returns the extension enumeration value corresponding to a given extension name string.

methods.name: GetBehaviorString
methods.description: Returns the string representation of a given extension behavior.

methods.name: IsExtensionEnabled
methods.description: Checks if a specific extension is enabled based on its behavior settings.
